subject: Marketplace voucher orchestration for PLG credits
messages:
From: Katie Chen <katie@cloudhub.io>
To: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@cloudhub.io
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: Partner credit program proposal for PLG signups

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the intro call last week. CloudHub is ready to pilot a partner-issued voucher flow that auto-provisions free credits to PLG signups coming from the CloudHub marketplace listing. High-level ask: can Redwood support a partner-generated voucher bundle (25 credits each) redeemable via self-serve sign-up, with reporting back to CloudHub for co-marketing credit reconciliation?

What we can provide today:
- CSV with partner rules and promo codes (attached: cloudhub-voucher-rules.csv)
- A partner API endpoint we can call once a user redeems a voucher to notify CloudHub
- A short 60-day pilot window and up to 5k vouchers to start

Questions for you:
1) Do you have an API or endpoint for partner-driven voucher activation or do we need to use the marketplace voucher flow?
2) Any limits on per-account issuance / TTL?
3) Required legal/finance MOU before issuance?

Would love to scope basic integration steps this week so we can do a sandbox test before marketplace activation.

Best,
Katie Chen
Partner Programs, CloudHub
attachments: cloudhub-voucher-rules.csv (CSV)

From: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Katie Chen <katie@cloudhub.io>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 12:24:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Partner credit program proposal for PLG signups

Katie — thanks for the clear summary and file. Appreciate the sample volume. I pulled in Lauren (marketplace ops) and Priyom (growth ops) to shape integration details. Quick answers up front:
- We can support partner-issued vouchers via our marketplace and also via a partner API mapping, but behavior differs (marketplace: single-use marketplace vouchers; partner API: we can accept signed webhook calls to mark accounts).
- Per-account issuance: we recommend capping to 1 voucher per account for PLG to prevent gaming; TTL we can set to 90 days for the pilot.
- MOU: yes — simple MOU with redemption terms is standard, can be lightweight.

Next steps:
1) Priyom, can you confirm whether the partner can POST redemption events to the voucher endpoint (voucher-api-spec.md) and how we reconcile?
2) Lauren, can you confirm marketplace vs partner-api recommended path for CloudHub specifically?

Katie, can you also confirm whether CloudHub needs a co-branded landing page or just the marketplace listing?

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Strategic Partnerships — Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 415-555-0132

From: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 15:40:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Partner credit program proposal for PLG signups

Folks — looping you in with the attachments Katie sent. Attaching a rough API spec we use for partner redemption (voucher-api-spec.md). Core requirements:
- Partner posts a redemption event with partner_voucher_id, user_email, timestamp, and HMAC signature
- We validate HMAC and map voucher to internal promo bucket
- We emit a webhook to partner endpoint after issuance for reconciliation

Operational asks:
- Priyom: can growth ops set up a HubSpot workflow that marks leads as "voucher_assigned" and triggers the backend mapping? I think a HubSpot id will help reconciliation.
- Lauren: timeline preference — marketplace listing activation vs partner-API pilot? Marketplace is simpler for CloudHub UX but may be slower to approve.

Attaching: voucher-api-spec.md

Thanks,
Sean

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Katie Chen <katie@cloudhub.io>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Partner credit program proposal for PLG signups

Sean / Lauren / Katie — quick plan from Growth Ops side:
1) We'll wire up the HubSpot workflow (sample id attached: hubspot-workflow-id-4890.txt) that tags inbound marketplace leads with partner_source=cloudhub and creates a custom property voucher_issued:true.
2) For reconciliation, Growth Ops will export a nightly digest (S3 CSV) with voucher_id, redeemed_at, user_email and push to CloudHub SFTP or provide API pull.
3) For pilot, recommend 2 phases: a) API pilot (internal test, 200 vouchers) b) Marketplace wide roll after MOU signed (up to 5k).

Notes:
- We should enforce one voucher per unique email + device fingerprint.
- TTL set to 90 days per Sean, suggest we code for 120 days in case of delays.

Open items: who signs the MOU and finance contact at CloudHub?

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Growth Ops — Redwood Inference
attachments: hubspot-workflow-id-4890.txt

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Katie Chen <katie@cloudhub.io>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 14:33:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Partner credit program proposal for PLG signups

Katie — great to see this moving forward. From Marketplace Ops perspective:
- Marketplace voucher path is preferred for UX (single click on listing -> voucher applied) but requires listing review (2–3 business days) and a quick tax/finance check.
- If CloudHub needs faster time-to-test, we can run the API pilot first.

I've drafted a short MOU to cover voucher volume, redemption limits, and reporting cadence (attached: MOU-draft.pdf). Marissa from Finance is cc'd to help with any billing reconciliation or promo accounting.

Proposed timeline:
- Today: finalize MOU language (we ask CloudHub to sign e-signature)
- Thu (5/6): run API pilot (200 test vouchers) in sandbox
- Mon (5/10): marketplace listing submission if pilot looks good

Action items:
- Katie: confirm CloudHub finance contact and sign MOU link here: https://docusign.com/MOU/abcdef123456
- Priyom: prepare nightly reconciliation CSV and SFTP or API endpoint
- Marissa: please confirm promo accounting code to use.

Thanks,
